changelog: Added MCUnifiedWardrobeWidget / WBP_UIWardrobe with stepped blue frame, three-column catalogue, separate selected-item detail, try-on, buy/apply/back and expandable colour controls.
Added MCUnifiedShopWidget / WBP_UIShop with two-column catalogue, selected detail, buy/back and the existing four replacement-slot actions.
Enabled Wardrobe/Boosters screens in WBP_UIRoot and session-only screen/language preview. Root now contains 121 saved editable UMG widgets.
Existing menu/scoreboard/wardrobe/shop remain the owners of game state and accepted actions. New views mirror source controls and forward actions; no second economy or settings save path.
Added bounded catalogue/detail scrolling, two-axis narrow-viewport overflow, content-sized controls and translated labels at authored fonts. Bounded purchase captions wrap into additional lines.

Extracted four original PSD wardrobe icons without modifying the PSD; imported three glyph textures for matching existing CowboyHat, FootballHelmet and SquareGlasses items. No new catalogue product added.
Reused existing localization catalogue; added UI.V2.Shop.ComingSoon in ten languages for the Designer fixture, and reused UI.Settings.Back.
Kept non-cosmetic icons in DT_Perks.Icon; DT_Perks and DT_HubCatalog rows were not changed.
